sections.title: Small arctic and alpine herb
sections.text: Nodding saxifrage grows in cool, wet places such as tundra, mossy banks and late snowbeds. Its basal leaves are rounded to kidney-shaped, shallowly lobed and only about 3–20 mm across.

sections.title: Flowers and bulbils
sections.text: The flower stem may reach 30 cm; its white petals are about 5–12 mm long. Flowers droop in bud, and vegetative bulbils often replace some flowers, helping explain the dark reddish structures shown on the plate.

sections.title: Food and caution
sections.text: The floras consulted describe its habitat and reproduction but do not establish an edible use or a toxicity profile.
